forumWorkshop.title: The Middle Corridor.
forumWorkshop.intro: Two days of regional dialogue and practical exploration of digital transit, bringing together the customs community, business and technology partners.
forumWorkshop.comingSoonText: The programme will be published here as soon as it is available.
forumWorkshop.localTime: All times are local to Chișinău.
forumWorkshop.forumAudience: National Customs Association (ANV), Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), initiative partners, customs administrations, international organizations, development partners, business representatives and international guests.
forumWorkshop.workshopAudience: Digital service providers and technology companies; transport and logistics companies, freight forwarders and transit operators; customs and other transport-related stakeholders; business associations and chambers of commerce.

opening.title: Official opening
speakers: Radu Burduja — Forum opening speech; moderator — Euro-Atlantic Institute for Building Resilience
Virgiliu Mitu — President of the ANV
Niclas Rueffer — Digital Transformation of SMEs in Eastern Partnership Countries (DT4SME)
Radu Vrabie — Director of the Customs Service of the Republic of Moldova
Vadim Muntean — Vice President of the ANV
Sergiu Tonu — Project Manager of Digital Transit Hub

welcome.title: Welcome speeches
speakers: Vakhtang Lashkaradze — Revenue Service of Georgia
Fikrat Alasgarli — Fikrat Alasgarli & Partners Customs and Tax Consultancy
Umut Sedele — SDL Authorized Customs Consultancy
Piotr Ciarkowski — PUIG / signing of protocol with ANV

trade.title: Welcome address: facilitating international transport and trade
speakers: Vasile Soiman — National Professional Association of Customs Officers of Romania (ANPLVR)
Victor Pantiru — Pantiru & Partners Associated Law Firm
Dorel Noroc — Association of Banks of Moldova (ABM)

keynote.title: Keynote — The future of digital transit
keynote.description: International trends in digital customs, electronic data exchange, interoperability, smart borders and digital transit corridors.

hub.title: Digital Transit Hub — From concept to regional instrument
hub.description: Presentation of the solution; live demonstration; functionalities; user experiences; development directions.
speakers: Sergiu Tonu — Project Manager of the National Customs Association of Moldova (ANV)

business.title: Business & logistics panel — What does business need from digital customs?
business.description: Participants: carriers, logistics operators, customs brokers, importers/exporters, professional associations and business organizations. The session will identify user problems, costs and delays, information needs, data duplication, automation opportunities and priority functionalities.

closing.title: Closing conclusions
closing.description: Presentation of the main conclusions and transition to the workshop on the following day.

reception.title: Networking reception
reception.description: Space for professional relationships, informal exchange of experience, identification of future partnerships and international networking.

opening.title: Official opening
speakers: Virgil Mitu — President of the National Customs Association of Moldova (ANV)
Vadim Muntean — Vice President of the National Customs Association of Moldova (ANV)

digitalization.title: Session I — Digitalization of the transit corridor
speakers: Igbal Babayev — Chairman of MCTAC; MCTAC Digital Transit Hub
Mario Apostolov — UNECE; organizational and technical aspects of the MCTAC Digital Transit Hub
Sergiu Tonu — Project Manager of the National Customs Association of Moldova

journey.title: Session II — Workshop: digital transit journey
journey.description: Practical exploration of end-to-end transit procedures. A practical case study for MCTAC country partners and users.
speakers: Igbal Babayev — Moderator; Chairman of MCTAC

simulation.title: Session III — Simulation exercise: practical application of transit procedures in real-time scenarios
simulation.description: Practical, hands-on exercise on transit procedures, simulating real-time operational scenarios.
speakers: Igbal Babayev — Moderator; Chairman of MCTAC

closing.title: Closing remarks
closing.description: Recommendations and alignment among key stakeholders. Closing remarks.
speakers: Bahar Arabova — GIZ Azerbaijan / Digital Transformation of SMEs in Eastern Partnership Countries (DT4SME)
